verdict.rationale: Probes confirm docs.github.com serves a working llms.txt (HTTP 200) and provides markdown-formatted docs (copilot.md) that an AI agent could be pointed at directly for agent-oriented consumption. This is concrete technical evidence beyond marketing claims that the docs are structured for agent ingestion. Missing for 10: independent/community confirmation of an agent actually being pointed at llms.txt and successfully using it, and evidence that this coverage extends comprehensively across all Copilot doc pages rather than just the root/index.
